latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bitwarden-hardened.

- Securely access and manage Bitwarden/Vaultwarden passwords using the rbw CLI.
- Includes detailed setup, usage, and agent guidance for Linux and macOS.
- Introduces strong, opinionated security guardrails for all credential access and vault-modifying operations.
- Ensures confirmation and explicit user intent before any destructive changes or sensitive actions.
- Prevents exposure of secrets via command arguments, shell exports, and networked processes.
- Supports tmux and pinentry-curses integration for password prompts.
